## What you should be able to do tonight

- Rank every remaining simplification by how much it would change a reported result, with a magnitude estimate for the top five.
- Say which of them you will fix this year and which you will not, with the reason.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>55 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [35 min]{.task-min} Rank last night's list by estimated impact, and put a number on the top five. For each, say how you estimated it: a sensitivity run, a bound, or an assumption you are stating. Fills at the close, the assumed impact coefficient, the missing delisting returns, the borrow rate assumption and the absence of intraday sequencing will be near the top.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [20 min]{.task-min} Write the disposition for each: fixed in phase 9, fixed in phase 10, not fixable with free data, or accepted. A limitation with a plan attached reads differently from one without.
:::
:::
